shot.image_note: adult woman, dark hair slicked back, metallic geometric top, black photo studio, hard key light
shot.beat: She steps closer to the camera, tilts her head back and runs both hands up through her slicked-back hair, then smiles.
shot.prev_beat: She slowly lifts the metallic top off over her head, tosses it aside and turns her bare upper body toward the key light, holding eye contact.
